title: Input latency and hit-testing
blurb: Measure Interaction to Next Paint (INP) on moving HTML-in-canvas controls, and the per-frame cost of calling updateElementGeometry() and toggling an attribute to clear Chromium's hit-test cache across 1 to 200 controls.
question: How much Interaction to Next Paint (INP) latency does HTML-in-canvas add to real taps, drags, and typing inside moving or transformed controls, and what is the frame-time and INP cost of calling updateElementGeometry() plus the attribute-toggle workaround required to clear Chromium's hit-test cache across 1 to 200 moving controls?
